from pickle import dump, load
from numpy import array
from PyQt5.uic import loadUi
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication
from PyQt5 import QtWidgets


def affiche_f1(n):
    f1 = open("etudiant.dat", "rb")
    windows.aff_etudiant.setRowCount(n)
    for i in range(n):
        etd = load(f1)
        windows.aff_etudiant.setItem(i, 0, QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(str(etd['num_insc'])))
        windows.aff_etudiant.setItem(i, 1, QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(etd['np']))
        windows.aff_etudiant.setItem(i, 2, QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(str(etd['mg'])))
        windows.aff_etudiant.setItem(i, 3, QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(str(etd['fs'])))
        windows.aff_etudiant.setItem(i, 4, QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(str(etd['i'])))
        windows.aff_etudiant.setItem(i, 5, QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(str(etd['bonification'])))
        windows.aff_etudiant.setItem(i, 6, QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(str(etd['fg'])))
    f1.close()


def verif_alpha(ch):
    i = 0
    while i <len(ch) and ("A" <= ch[i].upper() <= "Z" or ch[i] == " "):
        i += 1
    return i == len(ch)


def occurence(num, n):
    occ = 0
    f1 = open("etudiant.dat", "rb")
    for i in range(n):
        etd = load(f1)
        if etd["num_insc"] == int(num):
            occ += 1
    f1.close()
    return occ


def verif():
    num_inscrit = windows.num_insc.text()
    np = windows.np.text()
    b = windows.bonification.currentIndex()
    mg = windows.mg.text()
    fs = windows.fs.text()
    if num_inscrit == "" or not num_inscrit.isdigit() or occurence(num_inscrit, n) > 0:
        windows.erreur.setText("Numéro inscrit invalide")
        return False
    elif not (len(np) in range(1, 31) and verif_alpha(np)):
        windows.erreur.setText("Nom et prénom invalide")
        return False
    elif mg == "" or float(mg) < 0 or float(mg) > 20:
        windows.erreur.setText("Moyenne générale invalide")
        return False
    elif b == 0:
        windows.erreur.setText("Bonification invalide")
        return False
    elif fs == "" or float(fs) < 0:
        windows.erreur.setText("Formule spécifique invalide")
        return False
    elif windows.ir.isChecked() == False and windows.ino.isChecked() == False:
        windows.erreur.setText("Index invalide")
        return False
    else:
        windows.erreur.setText("")
        return True


def ajout():
    global n
    if verif():
        etd = {}
        f1 = open("etudiant.dat", "ab")
        etd["num_insc"] = int(windows.num_insc.text())
        etd["np"] = windows.np.text()
        etd["mg"] = float(windows.mg.text())
        etd["fs"] = float(windows.fs.text())
        etd["bonification"] = float(windows.bonification.currentText())
        if windows.ir.isChecked():
            etd["i"] = 1
        else:
            etd["i"] = 1.05
        etd["fg"] = ((5 * etd["mg"] + etd["fs"]) * etd["i"]) + etd["bonification"]
        dump(etd, f1)
        n += 1
        f1.close()
        affiche_f1(n)


def transfert_f_t(t, n):
    f1 = open("etudiant.dat", "rb")
    for i in range(n):
        t[i] = load(f1)
    f1.close()


def transfert_t_f(t, n):
    f1 = open("etudiant.dat", "wb")
    for i in range(n):
        dump(t[i], f1)
    f1.close()


def tri():
    transfert_f_t(t, n)
    for i in range(0, n - 1):
        pos = i
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if t[j]["fg"] > t[pos]["fg"]:
                pos = j
        if pos != i:
            t[i], t[pos] = t[pos], t[i]
    transfert_t_f(t, n)
    affiche_f1(n)


def organiser():
    windows.g1.clear()
    windows.g2.clear()
    windows.g3.clear()
    f1 = open("etudiant.dat", "rb")
    g1 = open("groupe1.txt", "w")
    g2 = open("groupe2.txt", "w")
    g3 = open("groupe3.txt", "w")
    n1 = int(n * 0.3)
    n2 = int(n * 0.4)
    j, k, l = 0, 0, 0
    for i in range(n):
        etd = load(f1)
        if i in range(0, n1):
            g1.write(str(etd["num_insc"]) + "\n")
            windows.g1.insertItem(j, str(etd["num_insc"]))
            j += 1
        elif i in range(n1, n1 + n2):
            g2.write(str(etd["num_insc"]) + "\n")
            windows.g2.insertItem(k, str(etd["num_insc"]))
            k += 1
        else:
            g3.write(str(etd["num_insc"]) + "\n")
            windows.g3.insertItem(l, str(etd["num_insc"]))
            l = l + 1

    f1.close()
    g1.close()
    g2.close()
    g3.close()


def recherche(x, chem):
    f = open(chem, "r")
    trouve = False
    ch = f.readline().strip()
    while ch != "" and trouve == False:
        if ch == x:
            trouve = True
        else:
            ch = f.readline().strip()
    return trouve


def recherche_groupe():
    numr = windows.numr.text()
    if recherche(numr, "groupe1.txt"):
        windows.aff_group.setText("groupe1")
    elif recherche(numr, "groupe2.txt"):
        windows.aff_group.setText("groupe2")
    elif recherche(numr, "groupe3.txt"):
        windows.aff_group.setText("groupe3")
    else:
        windows.aff_group.setText("numéro invalide")


app = QApplication([])
windows = loadUi("interface_orientation.ui")
windows.show()
n = 0
t = array([{}] * 1000)
windows.btn_ajouter.clicked.connect(ajout)
windows.btn_trier.clicked.connect(tri)
windows.btn_organiser.clicked.connect(organiser)
windows.btn_chercher.clicked.connect(recherche_groupe)
app.exec_()
